projects.name: Manufacturing Failure Analytics Pipeline
projects.type: Data warehouse, BI, and machine learning project
projects.summary: A CO4031 project that transforms the AI4I 2020 predictive maintenance dataset into a business intelligence workflow.
details: Includes raw exploration, preprocessing, ETL, PostgreSQL staging, star schema design, OLAP outputs, Streamlit dashboard, and optional XGBoost failure prediction.
Dashboard reads OLAP CSV outputs and shows KPIs, failure distribution, monthly trends, machine condition vs failure rate, product quality failure rates, and detail tables.
Data warehouse uses fact_machine_operations with date, product, failure type, and machine condition dimensions.
ML script trains an XGBoost classifier with SMOTE, scaling, ROC-AUC, confusion matrix, feature importance, SHAP explainability, and cross-validation.
projects.best_for: Showing data engineering, analytics thinking, dashboarding, and applied ML for manufacturing.

projects.name: Data Visualization & Dashboarding Projects
projects.summary: A manufacturing performance and downtime dashboard built to help supervisors scan performance, rank downtime losses, and recover line capacity.
details: Combines production logs, product standards, and downtime factors.
Uses Power Query cleanup, fact/dimension modeling, DAX measures, KPI cards, efficiency calculations, Pareto ranking, cumulative downtime, and conditional formatting.
Includes downloadable PBIX and synthetic production dataset.
projects.best_for: Showing Power BI, DAX, data modeling, Pareto analysis, and operational dashboard design.

projects.name: NPI Warehouse Management
projects.type: Static web app connected to Google Apps Script and Google Sheets
projects.summary: A browser-based warehouse management app for NPI stock review, inbound/outbound Excel processing, cycle count checks, and warehouse layout search.
details: Main page supports live stock loading, JSON/JSONP fallback, metric cards, inbound/outbound XLSX parsing, template export, adjustment submission, cycle count stock checks, and local cache.
Dashboard page renders a clickable warehouse layout from generated JavaScript data and highlights shelves by item number or finished good ID.
Uses Lucide, SheetJS XLSX, and ExcelJS from CDNs.
projects.best_for: Showing practical NPI digitalization, warehouse workflow understanding, spreadsheet automation, and client-side app design.

projects.name: OPF Simulation / Trimmer Assembly Line Simulator
projects.summary: A trimmer assembly line simulation project using time-study collection, Monte Carlo modeling, Yamazumi charts, flow simulation, and Arena files.
details: tool.html is the main Monte Carlo simulation and Yamazumi analysis app.
data_collection.html is a mobile stopwatch for shop-floor time-study readings.
Exports Yamazumi XLSX by populating a production template with JSZip and XML manipulation so charts and formatting are preserved.
Includes before/after reports, PDFs, Arena model files, videos, images, and workbooks.
Useful for comparing capacity scenarios, takt time feasibility, VA/Semi-VA/NVA mix, bottlenecks, and line balance.
projects.best_for: Showing simulation, time study, process improvement, and manufacturing decision support.

projects.name: Inspection Standard Tool
projects.summary: A web tool for placing uploaded images or PDF pages into an Excel inspection-standard template.
details: Supports image/PDF uploads, manual assignment to asset slots, draggable crop handles, proportional image insertion, paired merge slots, BOM checking, and Excel workbook generation.
Keeps BOM checks in the web app instead of writing BOM text into the output workbook.
Preserves pictures already embedded in template.xlsx and adds uploaded images to mapped placeholder regions.
projects.best_for: Showing quality documentation automation and practical QA workflow tooling.
